user.title: Add a library card
user.description: Add one card at a time. To follow several family members' cards, add the integration again for each card.

data_description.name: Whose card this is, such as Liisa. It names the card's device and entities.

reauth_confirm.title: PIN for {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The library no longer accepts the PIN of {name}'s card. Enter the card's current PIN.

error.invalid_auth: The library didn't accept the card number and PIN.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the Helmet web library. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This card has been added already.

data_description.renew_within_days: The Renew loans due soon button renews the loans that can be renewed and are due within this many days, overdue ones included. Each renewal uses up one of the item's renewals, so a renewal long before the due date wastes it. 0 is today.

renew_loans.name: Renew loans
renew_loans.description: Renews the loans of a library card that can be renewed: all of them, or those that match the titles or are due soon.

titles.name: Titles
titles.description: Renew only the loans with any of these in their title. Leave empty for all.

due_within_days.name: Due within
due_within_days.description: Renew only the loans due within this many days. Leave empty for all.

invalid_auth.message: The library didn't accept the PIN of {name}'s card.

card_not_loaded.message: The card of {name} isn't set up right now.
